annotations.title: Draw a share image (Open Graph card)

description: Draw a 1200 × 630 share image as SVG from a title and, optionally, a subtitle, a site name, a light or dark theme and an accent colour. Answers the SVG and notes; convert it to PNG before using it as og:image, since networks don't show SVG. Answers from what you send alone: nothing is fetched or stored.
name: generate_og_image
